verdict.rationale: Bulk operations are a fair axis for a cloud platform with a CLI, REST API and MCP server, but the evidence pack never documents an operation that acts on many items at once, such as bulk deleting deployments, batch environment-variable edits or multi-project actions. The REST API, CLI and MCP list tools are developer building blocks or single-item actions, so they earn no credit. Rate limits and concurrency limits are adjacent, not bulk-operation features.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
